target_customer: College and young adult consumers who buy line skips, cover and tickets; bars and venues that pay for the platform
problem: Long lines and cover charges at popular bars waste customers' time and cost venues revenue.
business_model: Marketplace and ticketing: take rate on LineSkip passes, cover, drinks and tickets, plus venue marketing tools
product_category: Consumer nightlife app and venue platform

founders.name: Max Schauff
education: University of Wisconsin-Madison (launched while in college)
founders.background_notes: Launch in Madison in February 2017 per alumni magazine summary.

technical_complexity.rationale: Mobile ticketing and payments app with venue integrations; the hard part was operations and venue sales, not technology.

defensibility.rationale: Campus by campus venue contracts and student habit give local network effects, but a rival could sign the same bars.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquirer found. LineLeap itself bought BuzzPass in July 2025 per deal trackers.

market_need_then: College bars had long lines and cover charges; a 2024 TechCrunch article says other line skip apps existed and LineLeap focused on college bars. The founders launched in February 2017 on their campuses.

branding.domain_note: Uses lineleap.com; trademarks LINELEAP (2021) and LINESKIP (2024) under Line Services, Inc.

identity.voice_and_tone: Playful and social: Fun, Faster; your best friend on a night out

branding.brand_signature: LineSkip pass and the Fun, Faster tagline
branding.community_and_virality: Student campus ambassadors and bar crawl T-shirts sold through the app; a student newspaper called it Disney Fast Pass for bars.

brand_strength.rationale: Name states the benefit, with campus ambassador marketing and student press; claims 2M plus users on 180 plus campuses.

pivots.from: Line skip passes at college bars
pivots.to: Broader venue platform with cover, events ticketing and BuzzPass acquisition
pivots.why: Company positioning as a venue and brand platform; exact timing not found

outcome_analysis: LineLeap grew from a 2017 campus launch to a claimed 800 plus bars and 2M plus users, raised from YC and angels including The Chainsmokers' Alex Pall, bought BuzzPass in July 2025 and announced a $200M valuation in November 2025. Campus ambassadors and a benefit-naming brand drove distribution. Round sizes beyond that are reported inconsistently, so funding is only partly known.
notes: 2025-11 valuation confirmed by Business Wire and Pulse 2.0; round amount not stated (PitchBook says $5M, CB Insights undisclosed) and label varies. A 2024 round of $10M at a $100M valuation (total $25M) appears in a search summary and aggregators but I did not open a primary article, so it is not recorded as a round. Total raised: over $30M per company release; CB Insights $29.09M. Earliest rounds (2019 seed) seen only in aggregator URLs. Team 50 on YC, site claims 800 plus bars. Competitor search found no dated competitor near 2019, so the list is empty. YC page says founded 2017.
